meta.name: DohFlow Design System
meta.concept: Emerald-green primary anchored on #006341 with a warm Saltillo-terracotta accent and warm-neutral grays. Finance semantics (gain/loss/warning/info). Dark mode is a token swap; the green brightens for contrast on dark surfaces. Type is a two-family pairing (ADR 0063): IBM Plex Sans is the DEFAULT and holds all numerals; Nunito is opt-in for display.

ui.$value: "IBM Plex Sans Variable", "IBM Plex Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
ui.$description: DEFAULT face (ADR 0063). Body, tables, forecasts, balances, forms and ALL numerals. Digits are uniform-width by default and it has a slashed zero, which is why it holds the money. Self-hosted via @fontsource-variable/ibm-plex-sans. NOTE: the @fontsource-variable package declares the family as 'IBM Plex Sans Variable' — the non-Variable name is kept as a fallback only. Getting this wrong falls back to system sans SILENTLY.

display.$value: "Nunito Variable", "Nunito", "IBM Plex Sans Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
display.$description: OPT-IN face (ADR 0063). Wordmark, headings, hero and marketing copy. Rounded terminals pair with the claymation/pottery language. Variable default weight is 200 (ExtraLight) — always set a weight explicitly. Falls back to the UI face so a missing display font never lands on a system serif.

numeric.$description: Applied globally so money columns align. Use on every numeric/currency value.

semantics.gain: Positive money (deposits, surplus, gains). Ties to brand green.
semantics.loss: Negative money. Kept clearly redder than terracotta so a negative never reads as a highlight.
semantics.terracotta: Brand accent — illustrations, highlights, secondary chart series. NOT for negative money.
semantics.destructive: Dangerous actions (delete, irreversible). Same hue family as loss.
